sources.title: JSR-305 ThreadSafe and Immutable annotations
sources.version_or_date: Commit 151fd3976210c6b79117e30b02aee86a20ff5c7f; blob 0d7973b41be9e931db9d5d1853d926436ecf66e7 also identified as the old ThreadSafe blob in the 2008-08-25 diff.
sources.confirmed: The annotation describes classes whose public accesses preserve valid state across thread interleavings without extra caller synchronization; it does not require immutability.
sources.limits: Java's annotation covers public object operations broadly; any Rust adaptation must explicitly mean safety of concurrent access through shared references, rather than general thread transfer, deep immutability, or every possible operation. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C22.json.

sources.title: Boost shared_ptr shared-ownership terminology and separate thread-safety contract
sources.version_or_date: Boost 1.55.0; page explicitly says this release is from 2013.
sources.sections_read: Introduction, type parameter requirements, and const indirection signatures
sources.confirmed: The pointer manages shared lifetime while accepting broad pointee types; const pointer operations can expose mutable pointees.
sources.limits: Reference-count safety does not establish pointee safety, and ownership differs from borrowing. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C22.json.

sources.title: Qt reentrant versus thread-safe terminology
sources.sections_read: Definitions, Counter examples, const value() and mutable mutex, terminology caveat
sources.confirmed: Qt separates different-instance reentrancy from same-instance thread safety and demonstrates locking inside a const accessor.
sources.limits: Reentrant is too weak; the locking example must not become a required implementation strategy. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C22.json.

sources.title: D shared versus unshared/thread-local qualifier vocabulary
sources.version_or_date: Live D 2.0 FAQ; no dated snapshot established.
sources.sections_read: FAQ questions on shared guarantees, synchronization, barriers, and casts
sources.confirmed: D shared means possible access by multiple threads; memory barriers and synchronization are separate concerns. Redirected to https://dlang.org/articles/faq.html.
sources.limits: D shared is not an equivalent guarantee of concurrent-sharing safety. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C22.json.

sources.title: Reference-immutability and isolation qualifiers for safe parallelism
sources.confirmed: The publication is identified as MSR-TR-2012-79, October 2012, and describes a combination of immutable and isolated types for safe parallelism.
sources.limits: The paper's readable reference forbids mutation through that reference, unlike Rust shared access with interior mutability, so readable or immutable cannot be transplanted as an equivalent name for the trait. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C22.json.

sources.title: msr-tr-2012-79.pdf
sources.version_or_date: Extended version of MSR-TR-2012-79; publication page dates the report to October 2012; URL upload path is not treated as its publication date.
sources.sections_read: PDF opened through publication-page link; introduction and sections 2, 2.1, and 2.2, especially the four reference qualifiers and parallelism conditions
sources.confirmed: The paper separates writable, readable, immutable, and isolated references; readable views may coexist with writable aliases, so safe parallel sharing requires further restrictions on writable access. These qualifiers therefore distinguish a reference's permissions from the conditions for concurrent safety.
sources.limits: This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C22.json.
